judgments.reason: The passage explicitly states: 'We introduce CARLA, an open-source simulator for autonomous driving research.'
The passage says CARLA 'has been developed from the ground up to support development, training, and validation of autonomous urban driving systems.' This matches the claim exactly.
The passage states: 'CARLA provides open digital assets (urban layouts, buildings, vehicles) that were created for this purpose and can be used freely.' This matches the claim.
The passage says: 'The simulation platform supports flexible specification of sensor suites and environmental conditions.' This is directly stated.

The passage says: 'We use CARLA to study the performance of three approaches to autonomous driving: a classic modular pipeline, an end-to-end model trained via imitation learning, and an end-to-end model trained via reinforcement learning.' This matches the claim.
The passage states: 'The approaches are evaluated in controlled scenarios of increasing difficulty, and their performance is examined via metrics provided by CARLA.' This matches the claim.
